summary: BrightSpire Capital's subsidiaries signed a June 12, 2026 purchase and sale agreement and closed on September 14, 2026 the disposition of the Net Lease 1 Investment, two industrial properties in Tolleson, Arizona and Tracy, California, to ALTOAZ001 LLC and ALTRCA001 LLC. Total consideration was $300.0 million, comprising buyer assumption of a $94.0 million mortgage loan, affiliate assumption of a $106.0 million mezzanine loan, and $97.9 million cash net of closing and transaction expenses. Pro forma financials were furnished as Exhibit 99.1. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. Watch deleveraging, retained asset exposure, and redeployment risk.
